filters: D6: list_match_events accepts community, cursor, entry, limit and as_of only. The frame filter chips are not rendered; no filter behavior is invented.

ENn8Q.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, clip 0,0,390,844
ENn8Q.justification: The frame draws filter chips (This week, Competitive, Friendly, My level) and one fused meta line. list_match_events has no filter arguments (D6), so the chips are omitted and participation, level range and creator render as separate muted lines. Card order (time/price, venue, chips, participation), day headings, segment track, 20px gutter and 44px/48px controls are probed exactly. Times and day rows are masked because fixture instants move with the clock. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.

kYI9H.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, clip 0,0,390,844
kYI9H.justification: The frame is the filtered-empty state (Clear filters + Create match). No filter exists (D6), so the route renders the truthful empty state with one Create match action and a hint line. Header, segment track and empty card are probed exactly. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.

uePpj.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, clip 0,0,390,844
uePpj.justification: Fixture venues, times and counts differ from the sample. Creator/organizer badges are not rendered as personal chips (existing behavior is preserved). Day heading, card order and chip tones are probed exactly; times and day rows are masked. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.

w25dY.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, clip 0,0,390,844
w25dY.justification: The frame rows (W/L glyph, score, disputed/cancelled copy) are the statistics MatchHistory feature, masked here and owned by the statistics units; the event cards follow the Clubhouse card. Past is flat with no day headings. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.
